_note: Narration per language. `text` is shown in captions; `say` (optional) is what the TTS reads when pronunciation needs help (see docs/lessons.md). `scene` groups lines into scenes, in order.

lines.text: Welcome to OpenHEXA! Here's a quick start for B-REACT partners.
lines.say: Welcome to Open Hexa! Here's a quick start for B React partners.

lines.text: B-REACT workspaces live in Bluesquare's OpenHEXA organization. Each one holds files, a database, pipelines, notebooks and web apps.
lines.say: B React workspaces live in Bluesquare's Open Hexa organization. Each one holds files, a database, pipelines, notebooks and web apps.

lines.text: Those stay in their workspace. What moves between workspaces is the dataset.
Your role sets what you can do. Viewers download and run pipelines. Editors also upload, publish data and use notebooks. Admins manage members.
It starts with an invitation email. Click Join Now, add your name and a password, and you land in the workspace.
Files is the workspace's shared folder. Click Upload files, drop your files in, and any member can download them.
When data is ready for others, publish it as a dataset. It keeps every version, documents each column, and controls who can see it.
In Datasets, click Create, then Create new version, add a changelog and drop in your files.
In the Files tab, preview the data, and check each column's statistics, like missing and distinct values.
Hover over a column and click the pencil to describe it, with attributes like unit or source.
Need an older release? Pick it in the version selector, then download the file.
To share it, open Access management and click Share with a workspace. Partners get every new version, read-only.
For analysis, open JupyterHub: notebooks in Python or R, with the OpenHEXA SDK installed and already signed in to the workspace.
lines.say: For analysis, open Jupyter Hub: notebooks in Python or R, with the Open Hexa S.D.K. installed and already signed in to the workspace.

lines.text: Read a dataset into a data frame by its identifier, or create datasets and publish new versions from code.
Prefer RStudio? Install the openhexa R package from GitHub, and sign in with an access token.
lines.say: Prefer R Studio? Install the Open Hexa R package from GitHub, and sign in with an access token.

lines.text: Your tokens are in Account settings, under Access tokens: one per workspace. Click the eye to show it, then copy it.
Inside RStudio, login() opens a dialog: paste the token, pick the workspace, and you're in.
lines.say: Inside R Studio, login opens a dialog: paste the token, pick the workspace, and you're in.

lines.text: Or pass the token, server and workspace to login() as arguments, reading the token from an environment variable.
lines.say: Or pass the token, server and workspace to login as arguments, reading the token from an environment variable.

lines.text: Then read datasets as data frames, create datasets and new versions, and publish a chart as a web app with publish_webapp().
lines.say: Then read datasets as data frames, create datasets and new versions, and publish a chart as a web app with publish web app.

lines.text: Pipelines automate recurring work, like extracting data from DHIS2. Click Run, fill in the parameters, and the outputs appear when it's done.
lines.say: Pipelines automate recurring work, like extracting data from D.H.I.S. 2. Click Run, fill in the parameters, and the outputs appear when it's done.

lines.text: Editors create new ones from a template, from a notebook, or in Python with the SDK.
lines.say: Editors create new ones from a template, from a notebook, or in Python with the S D K.

lines.text: Admins invite colleagues from Settings, Members. Pick the lowest role that covers their work.
Web apps share dashboards and visualizations. Click Create, describe the dashboard you want, and AI builds it.
lines.say: Web apps share dashboards and visualizations. Click Create, describe the dashboard you want, and A.I. builds it.

lines.text: AI also writes SQL in Data Studio, and you can connect Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini to OpenHEXA through MCP.
lines.say: A.I. also writes SQL in Data Studio, and you can connect Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini to Open Hexa through M.C.P.

lines.text: AI never sees more than your account can, and you review what it proposes before you use it.
lines.say: A.I. never sees more than your account can, and you review what it proposes before you use it.

lines.text: Want OpenHEXA for another project? Click Create your own organization in the sidebar to set one up in the Bluesquare Console.
lines.say: Want Open Hexa for another project? Click Create your own organization in the sidebar to set one up in the Bluesquare Console.

lines.text: Step-by-step guides are at docs.openhexa.com, in English and French. Welcome aboard!
lines.say: Step-by-step guides are at docs dot open hexa dot com, in English and French. Welcome aboard!
